features.title: Breathable fabric for lasting freshness
features.text: Upholstered in breathable fabric, this sofa keeps you cool and comfortable, making it perfect for warmer climates or long sitting sessions.

features.title: Mid-Backrest for Body and Shoulder Support
features.text: The mid-back design offers excellent lumbar support, ensuring you stay comfortable whether you’re reading, working, or just relaxing.

features.title: Spacious armrests, effortless comfort
features.text: Rounded armrests and a soft backrest provide gentle support, so you can sit comfortably for hours without strain.

features.title: Comfort that adapts
features.text: Soft foam cushioning ensures a plush yet supportive feel, making it a joy to relax or sleep on.

features.title: A little height, a lot more ease
features.text: Raised legs make cleaning under the sofa simple, helping you maintain a fresh and tidy space with minimal effort.
